context: Daichi watches Sho play in a sports tournament.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: しょう、頑張ってるな、本当に。
lines.en: Sho, you're really working hard at this.
lines.style: Warm Kansai lilt with genuine pride. Open attack on the name—direct, affectionate. Soft throughout, no edge. The regional accent sits comfortably in the chest, not performed. Steady belief threading the whole thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 応援、ありがとう、本当に。
lines.en: Thank you for cheering me on, really.
lines.style: Small, genuine voice from a six-year-old. Quiet sincerity—not trying to sound older. Soft attack on the gratitude. Real warmth, not parroted. The appreciation small and true.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: スポーツ、上手、なった、本当。
lines.en: Your sports have really gotten better.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with an uncle's pride watching improvement. Slight lilt on the improvement part—noticing it with genuine pleasure. Soft attack, no bluster. The affection easy and regional.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ダイチおじさんの、お陰。
lines.style: Small six-year-old voice. Humble without self-diminishing. Soft, sincere opening. The credit-giving is genuine, not performance. Quiet warmth, not performing gratitude.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai warmth with emotional depth. Open, clear on the happiness—not hiding it. The togetherness carries weight. Soft Kansai swing, genuine affection in the chest register. A statement that matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: It's been fun, really—all this time.
lines.style: Small six-year-old voice, genuinely remembering the time spent. Soft opening. The 'all this time' has quiet appreciation in it. Real joy, not performed. Trails slightly on the remembering.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: これからも、一緒に、頑張ろう。
lines.en: Let's keep doing this together from now on.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with gentle promise. Open, clear conviction—not tentative. The togetherness carries warmth and intention. Soft attack, steady through to the end. Affection and commitment in the same breath.
